spec.body_markdown: ## Vector Subtraction\n\nA - B is the same as A + (-B): flip B's direction, then add head-to-tail. In components, D_x = A_x - B_x and D_y = A_y - B_y. Unlike addition, order matters: A - B is not the same as B - A (they point in opposite directions).
